services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: The Princeton Club offers a fun and exciting way to celebrate your child’s birthday! With a wide variety of food and activity options, it is sure to be a big hit with the kids! Party options can include our award winning Aquatics Center, Kids Gym with games, as well as activities such as Kids Yoga, Zumba, Kickboxing (age dependent) and more! Parties can only be done as a member of the Princeton Club. We also have party options for showers, business meetings and more. Indoor Pool & Kids Gym Parties available: Friday evenings, Saturday & Sunday afternoons for additional rental costs. Please note: Parties can only be booked by Members, and parties must order one of the food packages below.

services.name: Personal Training
services.desc: People join the Princeton Club with a variety of goals and our Personal Training Staff is here and ready to help you achieve! Our Personal Trainers are highly qualified and educated with nationally recognized certifications. In addition, we offer an array of solutions for people to get to their goals. Our trainers have helped thousands of our members to lose weight, build strength, recover from injury, train for sports, functionally train and more. Whether you are an elite athlete or someone who is thinking about beginning and exercise program, our trainers are dedicated to making sure you get on the right track.
